These findings suggest that the compound may act as a modulator of the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter through multiple pathways, possibly by influencing the activity of G-protein-coupled receptors or by interacting with downstream signaling molecules. The evidence is consistent with the compound being a potential regulator of bile acid transport, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated.
